reviews.comment: The quizzes and homework do not go together. He spends most of class time teaching you how to solve problems with excel or different online platforms, but then you are not allowed to use those resources on the quiz. You're allowed to bring a cheat sheet for the quizzes but after the first 6 ish quizzes its not even helpful.

This professor does not care about his students AT ALL. Heard from multiple students how he never allowed for excused absences no matter the circumstance. He always was rude to students and he grades super hard if he doesn't like you. Don't take him.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prepare to learn by yourself. Weekly quizzes comes from textbook and are exactly what he mentions on lecture days. Take picture of homework because you can't see it after submitting. He won't ask new or super difficult things in the quizzes, so homework and textbooks are enough for A. Quizzes may tricky with words so be careful!!!!

There are 12 homework's and 13 quizzes that make up your grade. The online textbook is absolutely terrible and is filled with mistakes. All this professor does during class is read from a PowerPoint and calls it a lecture. The quiz questions are rarely similar to what is in the textbook or the assigned homework's. Can't look at past quizzes either.

Hale does not know how to teach. There are weekly quizzes in class that are proctored. They are only a few questions long so if you miss one question your grade is screwed. Lectures are not beneficial at all. He reads off of a slideshow that makes no sense. Expect to have to teach yourself. There are no tests, but quizzes make up your whole grade.

He is rude, unapproachable, and a terrible teacher. He sets you up for failure and doesn't teach you what you need to know. He goes over no basics about the content and wastes class time with guest speakers who give meaningless speeches. He also makes horrible comments about students, steroids, and drugs all the time.

MAYS HAS COMPLETELY RE DONE THIS COURSE. 88% of your grade consists of IN CLASS PROCTORED quizzes. Lectures (which are extremely unhelpful as he reads directly off a powerpoint and expects us to already have an extremely strong base knowledge of stats) are no longer recorded. Take this class anywhere but here! Hale cannot teach!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a really cool guy that makes the syllabus short/sweet/to the point. There is no guessing or interpreting, everything is spelt out. Nothing is proctored and the lectures are posted online, so no attendance required. Easy class, but also easy to forget about. You can make an A easily, I forgot an exam (it was over Spring Break), so I got a B.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy
